description: Update frontend publishStore.ts to call the new publish_template RPC instead of doing a direct UPDATE to the template table. Update the corresponding test file to mock supabase.rpc('publish_template') instead of fromTable('template').update(). Run tests and build to confirm everything passes.
steps: In frontend/src/stores/publishStore.ts, replace the publishTemplate method body: instead of fromTable('template').update({status:'ACTIVE'}).eq('template_id', templateId), call supabase.rpc('publish_template', { p_template_id: templateId, p_user_id: userId }) where userId comes from useAuthStore.getState().user?.id. Keep the projectStore sync and error handling.

In frontend/src/stores/__tests__/publishStore.test.ts, update the publishTemplate test cases to mock supabase.rpc instead of fromTable('template').update(). The mock should return { data: templateId, error: null } on success. Update the DB trigger error test to use the rpc mock returning an error.
Run: cd /projects/sandbox/Bom/frontend && NODE_OPTIONS='' npx vitest run src/stores/__tests__/publishStore.test.ts -- confirm all pass
Run: cd /projects/sandbox/Bom/frontend && NODE_OPTIONS='' npx vitest run -- confirm full suite passes
Run: cd /projects/sandbox/Bom/frontend && NODE_OPTIONS='' npm run build -- confirm production build succeeds
acceptance_criteria: publishStore.publishTemplate calls supabase.rpc('publish_template', { p_template_id, p_user_id }) instead of direct table update
All existing publishStore tests pass with updated mocks
Production build succeeds with no type errors
findings: All 1205 unit/integration tests pass. 8 e2e test suites fail due to missing SUPABASE_URL env var (pre-existing, requires live Supabase instance). Production build succeeds with no type errors. The publishTemplate method now calls supabase.rpc('publish_template') with p_template_id and p_user_id params.
